title: Controller LCFB1
text: Load controller for turbine-governor model, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Speed reference (pu)}, {Initial power reference, P_ref0 (pu)}, {Controller deadband (pu)} sets the deadband of controller, {Maximum error, e_max (pu)}, {Frequency bias gain, f_b (pu)} sets the gain of frequency bias, {Proportional gain, K_p (pu)} sets the proportional gain for PI control, {Integral gain, K_i (pu/s)} sets the integral gain for PI control, {Power transducer time constant, T_pelec (s)} sets the time constant of power transducer and {Maximum output, I_rmax (pu)} sets the upper limit of the output. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Proportional gain, K_p (pu)
params.values: Proportional gain for PI control 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Integral gain, K_i (pu/s)
params.values: Integral gain for PI control 0.1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Power transducer time constant, T_pelec (s)
params.values: Time constant of power transducer 3.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Maximum output, I_rmax (pu)
params.values: Upper limit of the output 0.035 (default) | scalar
